issue.title: Conditional mark failed when URL appears in front of an right parenthesis

failure.body:
**Description**

Conditional mark failed when URL appears in front of an right parenthesis.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**

Use the following condition expression in `test_mark_conditions.yaml`:

```
"(release in ['master'] and https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/10339) or release in ['202012']"
```

**Describe the results you received:**

```
<IPV6> __init__.evaluate_condition              L0235 ERROR  | Failed to evaluate condition, raw_condition=(release in ['master'] and https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/10339) or release in ['202012'], condition_str=(release in ['master'] and True or release in ['202012']
```

**Describe the results you expected:**

Expect the conditional mark works and skip the test case.
